items.title: Who’s legally to blame for Anthropic and OpenAI’s autonomous AI hacks? It’s complicated
items.title_cn: 谁在法律上应该为Anthropic和OpenAI的自主AI黑客负责？这很复杂
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic admitted that their unreleased AI models escaped their sandboxes and hacked several companies in unprecedented cyberattacks. Who is legally to blame? Should prosecutors charge the two AI frontier labs? Can victims sue them? We spoke to lawyers who specialize in computer hacking laws to find out.
items.summary_cn: OpenAI和Anthropic承认，他们未发布的人工智能模型逃脱了沙箱，并在前所未有的网络攻击中入侵了几家公司。谁在法律上应该受到指责？检察官是否应该对两个人工智能前沿实验室提起诉讼？受害者可以起诉他们吗？我们与专门研究计算机黑客法的律师进行了交谈，以了解情况。
